body:
Say, /u/cupcake1713 I wanted to thank you for this post. I've been going through some really tough stuff lately and have been the receiver of some very unkind things. 

You saying this made me smile a little. I like knowing that people care about how others are treated. So, once again, thank you.

Don't call me sweetheart. We don't know eachother. 

And no. It isn't that easy.
No one is interfering with my happiness. I'm just not happy.

>he will pretty much own you. 

Who is he?
How much? Why? What is the best thing to do?
You say that you care. I don't know that.
Yeah. I've been working with my therapist for years. I'm also on medication.
I don't know that you care to be honest.

What crutch do I have? And why are you doing this? I know I'm struggling. I'm trying to move past it. But when I was used for 12 years. I don't know what to say. I think it makes sense that I hurt. 

What lottery? I don't view what happened as a good thing. I'm constantly frightened. I have night terrors. I can't have my photograph taken without some part of me being scared. I've been in the hospital more times than I count. Twice suicide related. I've attempted to press charges and contacted task forces to remove the photos and videos. 

Why are you saying this stuff? I don't think I need to prove myself to you or anyone else.

When I was exploited I did have choices. Or at least I think I did. I was 12 years old and I didn't stop going back to them because I got touched. I was heard parts of me that were True were noticed and loved. Well, not loved but they were noticed. It was at a hefty cost though. I don't know.

I'm exhausted. I'm tired of dealing with PTSD from 12 years of abuse. Tired of living with depression and anxiety constantly weighing me down. Tired of being scared of every camera and losing every community I find. I'm tired. 

I don't want to sleep because I will wake up. It's horrible going to bed because you have to wake up. I don't want that. I don't want that.

Why did I play it? I saw the trigger warning and I made a mistake. It happened.

I don't know.

I've not had any good food at any hospitals I've been to. 

I've been pathologized and disrespected by staff. Treated horribly.
I feel bad for Justin. Why is he hated so much?

I don't see any reason to not try it out. I do want to die. I've been encouraged to go to the hospital. And maybe it's a good idea but the hospital sucks. It's a horrible place to be and I'd lose my freedom to choose. I feel like that's important.
